# Cancel --run by id refuses an open run that another build started. The run keeps running, and the build that started it cancels it.
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitfile started

env E2E_BUILD=other
exitcode 1 beehave cancel --run item-7-r1
! exec beehave cancel --run item-7-r1
stderr '^beehave: the run belongs to another version of beehave: item-7-r1 started under version e2e\S* and this is other\S*\. Start version e2e to finish it, or run beehave resume 7 --on-this-build to move the run to this build from its last finished step$'
! stdout .

env E2E_BUILD=
exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\t'

exec beehave cancel --run item-7-r1
wait
exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tcancelled\t'

! grep '^implement' calls.log

-- hang --
plan
-- verdicts --
approve
